name: Generate payment link (deterministic)
trigger: \b(i want to pay|i need to pay|help me pay|how do i pay|how to pay)\b

actions.text: I can see your orders above. Which one would you like to pay for? Share the order ID or transaction reference and I'll generate your payment link right away.

notes: Lists customer's pending orders and asks them to pick one. The actual payment link generation (initiate_payment) is a write operation that requires explicit confirmation in the next step.
